top_signals.title: Krishnan: Bypassing Hormuz Won’t Displace Gulf Oil
top_signals.summary: Oil headed for the longest losing streak in more than a year, as Saudi Arabia moved to restart a key pipeline and the US flagged progress in talks with Iran to end a war that’s rocked the Middle East since March. Mekala Krishnan, Partner at McKinsey Global Institute spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa about the disruption in the Strait of Hormuz and its impact on oil. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: AI is killing the grunt work, forcing companies to rethink entry-level hiring
top_signals.summary: AI is becoming increasingly adept at tasks usually given to junior employees. Some fear the impact it might have on entry-level hiring.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
